# CoLab Lisbon

> CoLab Lisbon runs hands-on AI workshops and Claude courses in Lisbon, Portugal. Learn to build products, agents, and automations with Claude and Claude Code — in person, with a community of AI builders.

## Upcoming Workshop

- [Next Level AI](https://luma.com/o8lhzuz4): 2-day intensive workshop, August 22 & 23rd at Unicorn Factory, Lisbon. Go beyond basic AI prompting into advanced Claude techniques, operator-level frameworks, and multi-step agentic workflows. Day one: agentic thinking and workflow orchestration. Day two: automated systems for real business use cases.

## Pages

- [Home](https://colablisbon.com/): AI workshops and Claude courses in Lisbon
- [Claude Code Workshop](https://colablisbon.com/claude-code/): Hands-on Claude Code training
- [Team Training](https://colablisbon.com/team-training.html): Custom AI training for companies and teams
- [Own Your Stack](https://colablisbon.com/own-your-stack/): Build and own your AI stack
- [Use Cases](https://colablisbon.com/usecases/): Real-world AI automation use cases
- [90 Day Build](https://colablisbon.com/90daybuild/): 90-day product building program
- [Master Claude Course](https://colablisbon.com/master-claude/): Online course (founding-member pre-sell) — automate busywork, build apps, and run agents with Claude
